datasets.name: kpi_total_revenue
queryLines:
SELECT
  sale_date,
  ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,total_units
FROM
  retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales

datasets.name: 09f4500c
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,
    (completed_transactions + failed_transactions + pending_transactions) AS Total_transactions
FROM retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales;

datasets.name: a668f7eb
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,
    failed_transactions AS failed_transactions
FROM retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales;

datasets.name: 0ef2b62f
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,
    pending_transactions AS pending_transactions
FROM retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales;

datasets.name: 9ebd705a
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,
    completed_transactions AS completed_transactions
FROM retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales;

datasets.name: ef22e046
queryLines:
SELECT
    sale_date,
    ROUND(
        completed_transactions /
        (
            completed_transactions +
            failed_transactions +
            pending_transactions
        )* 100.0 ,
        2
    ) AS success_rate_pct
FROM retailanalytics.gold.daily_sales;
